name: print-social-orange-digital-marketing-expert-post-with-chevron-split
title: White and orange 'Digital Marketing Expert' post with a chevron split and orange-tinted photo
whatItIs: A square post with a white left side holding an orange and charcoal headline, quote and 'Learn more' pill, split from an orange-tinted photo of a smiling man at a laptop by a white chevron edge outlined in orange.
whatItMeans: Dynamic and confident; the chevron points readers from text to face.
techniques: Split text and photo with a chevron edge.
Tint the whole photo in the brand colour.
Underline the headline with a short accent bar.

vocabulary.definition: An image rendered in two colours.
